purpose: Focused D02 repair/over-correction screen. Hold D02's 115% primary preload fixed while increasing replaceable flyweight tip mass from the repaired 100% level through 150%. D02 and D02_P are retained as causal anchors. These are exploratory cases only; no outcome is prescribed or selected in advance.
unchanged: dynamic fixed-pivot flyweight mechanism and ramp geometry

screen_axis.selection_intent: If an over-corrected case is later promoted, prefer the least-extreme mass increase that clearly preserves primary traction while materially reducing severe-hill backshift relative to D02_M.

competitors.label: D02: weak tip + high primary preload
competitors.intent: Original adverse case: 65% replaceable tip mass with 115% primary preload. Retained as the failure-side anchor; no failure outcome is imposed.

competitors.label: D02: restore reference primary preload
competitors.intent: Existing one-change D02 intervention: retain 65% tips but restore reference primary preload. Retained to distinguish preload relief from increased centrifugal actuation.

competitors.label: D02: restore reference tip mass
competitors.intent: Existing one-change D02 intervention: restore reference tip mass while retaining the 115% primary preload. This is the 100% tip anchor for the over-correction screen.

competitors.label: D02 repair: 110% tip mass
competitors.intent: Increase replaceable flyweight tip mass to 110% while retaining D02's 115% primary preload. Test whether added centrifugal closing begins to reduce severe-hill backshift after traction has been repaired.

competitors.label: D02 repair: 120% tip mass
competitors.intent: Increase replaceable flyweight tip mass to 120% while retaining D02's 115% primary preload. Test the same repair axis without changing any secondary hardware.

competitors.label: D02 repair: 130% tip mass
competitors.intent: Increase replaceable flyweight tip mass to 130% while retaining D02's 115% primary preload. Probe a strong primary-closing over-correction on the same mechanism axis.

competitors.label: D02 repair: 140% tip mass
competitors.intent: Increase replaceable flyweight tip mass to 140% while retaining D02's 115% primary preload. Probe whether severe-hill backshift becomes clearly constrained by excessive primary centrifugal closing.

competitors.label: D02 repair: 150% tip mass
competitors.intent: Increase replaceable flyweight tip mass to 150% while retaining D02's 115% primary preload. Upper bound of the focused screen; included to bracket the over-correction transition if lower masses remain too close to D02_M.
